mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_inventory_lot_balance (warehouse_id, sku_id, lot_id, unit, quantity, version, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{skuId}, #{lotId}, #{unit}, 0, 0, #{operator}, #{operator}) ON CONFLICT (warehouse_id, sku_id, lot_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, warehouse_id AS warehouseId, sku_id AS skuId, lot_id AS lotId, unit, quantity, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM xsy_inventory_lot_balance WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND quantity > 0 ORDER BY lot_id FOR UPDATE
